review.limitations: Only P1.F2 hunks show actual implementation. P1.F1 adds tests without corresponding implementation changes. No tier 3 systemic benefit shown.
review.reason: Changes are substantive and bounded: they introduce an explicit token check and update instructions passed to the Desktop Agent. The implementation and relevant checks are visible. No broader capability or systemic risk reduction across components is demonstrated.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant for PostHog users relying on the Desktop Agent’s ability to read repositories and complete tasks requiring push access. Affects workflow completion and user guidance.
review.uncertainty: The exact impact depends on how often agents encounter unauthenticated sessions; adoption and incident avoidance cannot be inferred from this chunk alone.
